summary: Use become: true with become_method: enable for privileged network tasks, which requires network_cli or httpapi connections; it can be set in group_vars.
questions: How do I get into enable mode on a Cisco device with Ansible?
How do I set enable mode in group_vars?

answer_card.title: Use become for enable mode
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `become: true` and `become_method: enable` (task, play or playbook). It only works with `network_cli` or `httpapi` connections.

`group_vars` example:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: cisco.ios.ios
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
```
